findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services, get_subtitling_formats · Private data: create_inquiry, get_company_credentials, get_track_record · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services, get_subtitling_formats · Private data: create_inquiry, get_company_credentials, get_track_record · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
